Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Copper shows the largest increase in your cost breakdown; it sounds like protecting your margin against material-cost pressure is your main concern. We value our long-standing partnership and want an agreement that recognises justified cost changes while giving both sides predictability. How can we balance payment timing and price to support that stability?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
We acknowledge the verified volume increase and have adjusted our unit price accordingly.
Extending payment terms to 90 days would necessitate a price increase to offset financing costs, which contradicts your goal of price stability.
Therefore, we must maintain the 30-day payment term, allowing us to offer a revised price of €369.76.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have recognised the higher volume in your price while separately pricing the financing burden—it sounds like predictable business and cash flow are central to making price stability workable for you. We want a lasting agreement that recognises those costs and supports our partnership. How can the confirmed commitment support a further measured price adjustment without reopening the payment structure?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your preference to maintain the 90-day payment structure and have adjusted our offer to €373.55.

Our offer stands at a price of €373.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Extended payment terms incur financing costs that must be reflected in the unit price. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have accommodated our payment preference while explicitly linking it to financing costs—it sounds like recovering that burden is central to a sustainable agreement for you. We want a fair, evidence-based outcome that respects your confidential calculation and supports our long-standing partnership. What external benchmarks would you regard as a fair basis for resolving the remaining price question?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 360.92 per unit, 30 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your latest proposal. As the underlying parameters, including the volume of 6,110 units, remain unchanged, we are unable to adjust our price further. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Therefore, this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer of €369.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel stands; should you be able to commit to a higher volume, we would be open to reviewing the calculation. Which volume can you commit to? 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
